analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined to 48.9, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram maintains improvement but fails to turn positive. ADX at 9.3 indicates lack of trend strength. While a Higher Low is possible based on 5-day vs 20-day lows, a Lower High is also possible based on 5-day vs 20-day highs, creating directional uncertainty. Current price near the lower Bollinger Band suggests potential buying if further downside occurs, but absence of trend warrants a wait-and-see approach.
